name: Blood and balut with wormwood
nameVi: Tiết và trứng vịt lộn hầm ngải cứu
summary: Tiết and trứng vịt lộn hầm ngải cứu is the afternoon bowl in Hạ Long. The balut is boiled, then stewed with young wormwood and shredded ginger for two or three hours. Steamed blood is the side.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019.
taste: Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the blood is sweet and the wormwood is bitter, and each softens the other. VnExpress calls the leaf lightly bitter and fragrant.
howToEat: VnExpress says the cook wants young green ngải cứu, and shredded ginger. The balut is boiled first, then stewed on a low fire for two or three hours. In Hạ Long the blood is the usual companion.

Báo Quảng Ninh, 13 Mar 2019, says the sweet squares of blood soften the bitter leaf, and the leaf takes the smell off the blood. Stalls add a balut to the blood bowl and keep the pot on the stove. Afternoon is the hour that account gives.
Both accounts printed 10,000–20,000 đồng a set. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Cột 3, and chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2, on the 13 Mar 2019 account. VnExpress places a stall deep in chợ Cột 3, phường Hồng Hải. That ward name is the article’s.
seoTitle: Tiet and balut with wormwood in Ha Long
seoDescription: In Hạ Long, duck balut is stewed with young wormwood and ginger, and blood comes in the same bowl. The 2019 and 2021 set was 10,000–20,000 đồng. A current price is Check on arrival.
